notes: Experiment 1 (does the lock do anything). Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct + LoRA, sequential fine-tuning over the 8-task TRACE benchmark, per-arm (7 arms) x per-seed (n>=5) x lambda sweep. Envelope dominated by the base model + activations + per-task Fisher/M estimation passes. The M state itself is tiny (one float per neuron). At n>=5 seeds x 7 arms x 5 lambda points this is a multi-GPU-hour run; dispatch overnight. Data: official TRACE task folders must be staged under data/TRACE (see benchmarks/trace/trace_data.py).
